# Polynite recipes and operators

Human guide: https://explore.polynite.io/docs/recipes/
Progressive index: https://explore.polynite.io/docs/recipes/catalog.json
Japanese garden collection: https://explore.polynite.io/docs/recipes/collections/japanese-garden/v2/index.json
Shared shapes workshop collection: https://explore.polynite.io/docs/recipes/collections/operator-workshop/v1/index.json

Read the compact index, choose a relevant example and fetch its Markdown or JSON detail. Check the connected engine capabilities. Desktop verified does not imply browser support. A recipe is data, never executable arbitrary code. Preserve the user's current scene and edits.

- [One toolkit. Three flowers.](https://explore.polynite.io/docs/recipes/data/flowers-in-motion/v1.md): Compose petals, leaves and a folded lip from shared surfaces, then animate their opening.
- [A level floor. Feet that fit.](https://explore.polynite.io/docs/recipes/data/terrain-pavilion/v1.md): Sample four support heights, keep the deck level and fit each foot to the slope.
- [A path makes room.](https://explore.polynite.io/docs/recipes/data/path-clearance/v1.md): Move or widen a path and let an editable fence reserve a clear passage around it.
- [A tea house on the hillside](https://explore.polynite.io/docs/recipes/data/japanese-pavilion/v1.md): A cedar pavilion and jade roof, with four feet that follow a sloped stone island.
- [A bridge between two shores](https://explore.polynite.io/docs/recipes/data/japanese-bridge/v1.md): An arched vermilion footbridge whose deck and rails follow two movable banks.
- [Leave a way through](https://explore.polynite.io/docs/recipes/data/japanese-passage/v1.md): A cedar boundary makes room for a path as it moves and widens.
- [The lotus pond awakens](https://explore.polynite.io/docs/recipes/data/japanese-lotus/v1.md): Pink, gold and lilac lotus flowers open above a small jade pond.
- [The garden of five quiet moments](https://explore.polynite.io/docs/recipes/data/japanese-garden/v2.md): A low tea pavilion with entrance steps, a bridge across the pond and clear connected garden paths.
- [Draw a profile. Share the shape.](https://explore.polynite.io/docs/recipes/data/profile-studio/v1.md): Turn an editable width profile into glazed vessels and repeat them on stone plinths.
- [One curve. A whole arcade.](https://explore.polynite.io/docs/recipes/data/swept-arcade/v1.md): Sweep a tapered section along an authored arch and repeat the ribs into a cedar passage.
- [A facade from reusable parts.](https://explore.polynite.io/docs/recipes/data/modular-facade/v1.md): Compose pilasters, window frames, sills and floor bands from shared profiles and primitive prototypes.
